name: date-picker
title: Date picker
description: A button that opens a calendar and shows the chosen date.
a11y: The trigger is a button naming the field and the current value; it opens a dialog with the calendar.
Choosing a date closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger; Escape closes without changing.
All calendar keyboard behaviour applies inside.
With `clearable`, a "Clear date" button in the popover removes the date, closes it and returns focus to the trigger.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown on the button while no date is chosen. Default "Pick a date".

props.name: format
props.description: Intl options for the text on the button. Default: medium date.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the user opening the calendar.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default), `sm` for dense layouts or `lg` for prominent forms. Heights match Button, Input and Select at each size.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as having an error: sets `aria-invalid` and shows the error border.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class name for the trigger button.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the control when it is not inside a Field.

usage: import {DatePicker, Field} from '@monoline/react';
